title: Endpoint Schatten class properties of commutators on quantum tori
summary: We study endpoint Schatten class properties of commutators $[I_θ^ε,M_x]$ on quantum tori of dimension $d\geq2$, where $I_θ^ε$ is the Riesz potential of order $ε$ and $M_x$ denotes the left multiplication operator by an operator $x$ on quantum tori $\mathbb T_θ^d$. For $-\frac{d}{2}<ε<1$, $ε\neq0$, and $x\in L_1(\mathbb T_θ^d)$, we prove that $[I_θ^ε,M_x]\in \mathcal L_{\frac{d}{1-ε},\infty}$ if and only if $x\in\dot W_{\frac{d}{1-ε}}^1(\mathbb T_θ^d)$.
